title: Information Cell Coordinator (ICC) (I) (LtCol to Maj) NMOS (1702, 1706, 1707), DC I
raw_text:
7. MOS 1709, Information Cell Coordinator (ICC) (I) (LtCol to Maj) NMOS
(1702, 1706, 1707), DC I

    a. Summary. Information Coordinators plan, coordinate, execute and
assess the information warfighting function. These officers also advise
commanding generals, their staff sections and MAGTF commanders on the conduct
of information as well as the development of policy and doctrine for
information at as part of a larger information staff from the MEF major
subordinate command level up to joint/theater level staffs.

    b. Prerequisites. Security requirement: active top secret security
clearance with secure compartmented information (SCI) access.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Staff Operations in the Information
Environment Planner Course (SOPC), (M02HE5D), Quantico, VA.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Supervise the task organization and employment of the Information
Coordination Cell (ICC).

        (2) Serve as the subject matter expert to the commander and staff for
all lethal and non-lethal information effects in shaping the area of
operation to meet the commander's intents.

        (3) Participate in the conduct of the targeting process; supervise
and evaluate the execution of targeting in accordance with the commander's
guidance.

        (4) Develops information plans and information annexes to operations
plans for all operations, contingencies, and exercises.

        (5) Integrate information plans and advise the commander on the
conduct of information throughout the all-domain conflict continuum.

            (6) Provide information battlespace awareness to the commander.

        (7) Synchronize efforts with information related capabilities to
leverage capabilities and maximize effects.

        (8) Acts as a liaison for information forces that are not organic to
the MAGTF table of organization.

        (9) Provides subject matter expertise to the development of USMC
policy on information consistent with DoD policy.




                                          1-88                       Enclosure (1)
 1114                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Cyberspace Operations Officer, 1702.

            (2) Space Operations Staff Officer, 1706.

            (3) Influence Officer, 1707.

            (4) Basic Information Planner, 1781.

            (5) Space Operations Staff Officer, 1786.

            (6) Technical Information Operations Officer, 8834.

            (7) Space Operations Officer, 8866.

matches: Gather and organize information on problems or procedures.
Information Coordinators plan, coordinate, execute and assess the information warfighting function.
Study operations sequence, material flow, functional statements, organization charts, and project information to determine worker functions and responsibilities.

Complete the Staff Operations in the Information Environment Planner Course (SOPC), (M02HE5D), Quantico, VA. d. Duties (1) Supervise the task organization and employment of the Information Coordination Cell (ICC).
Develop expertise in subject matters related to committee assignments.
(2) Serve as the subject matter expert to the commander and staff for all lethal and non-lethal information effects in shaping the area of operation to meet the commander's intents.
Suggest or initiate personnel actions, such as promotions, transfers, or hires.
(3) Participate in the conduct of the targeting process.
Recommend or execute personnel actions, such as hirings, evaluations, or promotions.
supervise and evaluate the execution of targeting in accordance with the commander's guidance.
Develop or update project plans including information such as objectives, technologies, schedules, funding, and staffing.
(4) Develops information plans and information annexes to operations plans for all operations, contingencies, and exercises.
Develop defense plans or tactics, using intelligence and other information.
(5) Integrate information plans and advise the commander on the conduct of information throughout the all-domain conflict continuum.
Maintain air-to-ground and point-to-point radio contact with aircraft commanders.
(6) Provide information battlespace awareness to the commander.
Coordinate and link the computer systems within an organization to increase compatibility so that information can be shared.
(7) Synchronize efforts with information related capabilities to leverage capabilities and maximize effects.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
